recommendation: Keep this source fix. If Financial Management later wants PaymentNotice.paymentStatus to be optional, that should be handled by a new explicit Jira decision because the current issue record and source history support requiring it.
issue_request: FHIR-19494 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Financial Management change request for PaymentNotice raised against STU3. It asked to make the cardinalities for status, patient, created, and paymentStatus 1..1.
initial_application: The historical application commit f369c813fb40cd39c0db46336b2b3186f496fb47 included GF#19494 and changed the old PaymentNotice spreadsheet so PaymentNotice.status and PaymentNotice.created became 1..1, while PaymentNotice.paymentStatus remained 0..1. No current or historical PaymentNotice.patient element was found; the same batch and related FHIR-19495 work renamed the notification target to recipient, which is already required in current source.
additional_context: PaymentNotice is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini, and its authoritative current definition is source/paymentnotice/structuredefinition-PaymentNotice.xml. Searches for later PaymentNotice paymentStatus cardinality Jira decisions and relevant Zulip/Confluence discussion found no evidence that leaving paymentStatus optional was intentional.
reconciliation: Changed PaymentNotice.paymentStatus minimum cardinality from 0 to 1 in source/paymentnotice/structuredefinition-PaymentNotice.xml, leaving already-correct status, created, and recipient cardinalities unchanged.

related_jiras.note: Same PaymentNotice application batch renamed target to recipient, explaining why the seed's patient/party cardinality request has no separate current PaymentNotice.patient element to edit.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core PaymentNotice request to make status, patient, created, and paymentStatus 1..1.
evidence_items.learned: This is final WG intent for the seed cardinality change.

evidence_items.summary: PaymentNotice is active in the resource list, assigned to FM, in the patient compartment, maturity level 4, and approved.

evidence_items.summary: The active StructureDefinition has required status, created, recipient, and now paymentStatus elements.
evidence_items.learned: The source now carries the required cardinality for the remaining current element covered by the issue.

evidence_items.summary: Historical GF#19494 batch changed PaymentNotice.status and PaymentNotice.created to 1..1 but left PaymentNotice.paymentStatus at 0..1.

evidence_items.learned: No discovered later decision or community rationale conflicts with making paymentStatus required.
